title: Safety Evaluation of Dasatinib in Subjects With Scleroderma Pulmonary Fibrosis

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study was to evaluate the safety of Dasatininb in the treatment of scleroderma pulmonary interstitial fibrosis.

Posted outcomes: Number of Participants Who Died, Experienced Serious Adverse Events (SAEs), or Adverse Events (AEs). timeframe=From start of study drug therapy up to 30 days after the last dose. The duration. 100 mg Dasatinib, Oral Administration=0
